format: gzip (mtime 0) UTF-8 CSV, header row, rows sorted by product_id then site order (site04_roi3, site01_roi6, site07_roi1, site11_roi4). Empty cell = null. Booleans true/false. Stand-in for catalogue.parquet (no pyarrow in the venv).
row: one image x site overlap (an image covering two site squares has two rows; exactly one is_primary_row)

columns.product_id: canonical product id (ODE pdsid without nac./wac. prefix, upper case)
columns.ode_pt: ODE product type (CDRNAC4, CDRWAC4, CAL, TCWL2B, TCSL2B)
columns.emission_deg: ODE Emission_angle at the image centre (deg)
columns.incidence_deg: ODE Incidence_angle at the image centre (deg)
columns.phase_deg: ODE Phase_angle at the image centre (deg)
columns.pixel_scale_m: metres per pixel: ODE Map_resolution, else Map_scale, else instrument nominal (see pixel_scale_source)
columns.footprint_area_km2: area of ODE Footprint_SP_geometry (south-polar stereographic, not equal-area: area scale k^2 - 1 <= 4e-4 within 1.6 deg of the pole)
columns.footprint_width_km: footprint area / footprint bounding-box diagonal: an estimate of the strip width
columns.overlap_frac: fraction of the site's 10 km x 10 km stereographic square covered by the footprint
columns.footprint_suspect: footprint_width_km > 3 x nominal swath (cross-track samples x pixel_scale; tools/imagery/ode.py SWATH_SAMPLES); null = pixel scale unknown. ODE ShadowCam footprints are browse-map extents and are almost all flagged: their site coverage is unverified
columns.terrain: site-level descriptor from the site name (crater_rim, ridge, massif_peak); not a per-pixel classification
columns.sun_az_deg: JPL Horizons airless apparent azimuth of the Sun centre at the site centre at obs_utc (0 N, 90 E). Stratification only.
columns.sun_el_deg: same, elevation (deg) above the local horizontal of the 1737.4 km sphere (not the terrain horizon)
columns.subsolar_lat_deg: latitude of the Sun direction in the body frame, derived from sun_az/el at the site (the 'season' variable)
columns.az_bin: 8 x 45 deg compass bins centred on N, NE, ...
columns.is_primary_row: this row is the image's site with the largest overlap (ties by site order); the image's stratum is this row's
columns.prior_use: LROC NAC frame used by the earlier GSFC-ortho NAC comparison (tools/validation/nac); never held out
columns.label_url: PDS label URL (has sub-spacecraft position etc.; not fetched in bulk)
